scope: Completed fixed-geometry penalty experiments, a retained checkpoint re-audit, focused regressions and controlled browser comparison. Full release QA is still running and is not certified by this record.

subdivision.scope: Exact de Casteljau subdivision of a smooth curved slit and a straight slit; same geometry at every depth. Separation term disabled; no near-border or short-handle penalty at these sizes.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

limitations: Changing penalty normalization did not resolve the visible artifacts and is not deployed.

The first browser attempt failed before fitting on stale preview asset references; restarting the owned preview fixed the harness environment.
